banksText:
STREET-LEVEL (default since 2026-09-11, `format: street`): P1 = the reader's own experience in the second person, no setup; sections named by the phenomenon (The Gut · The Ledger · The Chip · The Floor · The Law · The Market · The Record) with MCPHeraldicCrest + emoji per header and the six-need spine in the mono directions lines; one-occupant sentences; 'Break it:' closes each phenomenon section; the market by section six; ≥3 unlabelled seed asides (BlogCallout) at full strength; evidence + npx + 'Count how many' in the last section; deep links to book + sibling post. Validate (compile!) MDX before commit. Image = the commit tolerance panel. Grounding + a scale collision, or it is wrong.
voice: no technique-name leaks in prose — name the map, the walk, the coordinates; never the internals
     ↳ mined: Avoid mentioning specific technique names in your explanation; refer to them only by their generic roles like 'the map' or 'the walk'.
the writing process includes the qwen ghost-read monologue gated at >=95 tri-check: qwen (weaker reader) monologues cold, Claude grades reality-vs-intent, revise sub-bar passages, re-monologue — publish only at 95+
     ↳ mined: * Galois's frame is "raise the assurance bar via proofs"; Elias's frame is "exit the regress class entirely." But they share readers — Galois's audience is precisely the readers who will recognize the substrate-engineeri
breadcrumb + crest per section (validated)
reader-POV first — what's in it for them
breadcrumb + crest per section (validated)
validate-mdx before commit — a 500 error/crash on a blog post is usually a forbidden character in the MDX text (triple-bar, not-equals, <NUMBER, <<), not a resolver bug
RESEARCH → BOOK → BLOG: add the book section first, quote it with deep links, verify anchors resolve in built HTML
crest VARIANTS encode meaning — never replace with 'default' (288 variants lost in the 2026-01-24 incident)
every section opens with the orthogonal-directions line + reader-facing lede; NO TABLES, prose with bold
panel wrong/missing on prod: check src/data/post-panels-index.json FIRST — a post missing from it (build-panels-index.mjs concurrent-write race, 2026-07-03) looks like staleness but a push won't fix it; run scripts/blog/build-panels-index.mjs + tests/blog/panel-index-current.test.mjs
the blog-list/OG share image is the DENSEST commit panel (bestPanelPathForSlug, src/lib/postPanels.ts) — NEVER encircled.png, a sparser excluded render (tests/blog/og-is-meaningful-commit-panel.test.mjs). Corrected 2026-07-03, this rule previously claimed the opposite.
every post carries its commit-encircles strip (drift history) at the TOP of the body — rendered automatically from post-panels/<slug>/manifest.json, one panel per edit-commit; the manifest IS the post's edit provenance, never delete it
the writing process includes the qwen ghost-read monologue gated at >=95 tri-check: qwen (weaker reader) monologues cold, Claude grades reality-vs-intent, revise sub-bar passages, re-monologue — publish only at 95+
the 6 needs live in the SUBTITLES (the mono orthogonal-directions lines), not the titles — connection, contribution, growth, uncertainty, certainty, significance in order, themed to the section; canonical-template-check.mjs is the door
voice: show the paradox, never name the feeling — banned: 'surprising/counterintuitive/remarkable'; put the two true things side by side
voice: concrete object or scene BEFORE the abstraction — the abstraction is the payoff, never the opener
voice: show the loss with the win — the honest failure mode, shown, is what makes the win credible
voice: no technique-name leaks in prose — name the map, the walk, the coordinates; never the internals
voice: density — cut any sentence that carries no mechanic, image, or turn of the paradox
voice: reader-as-hero — the sentence weight lands on the reader; 'we' rides in support
street-level is the default (operator 2026-09-11): P1 is the reader's own experience in the second person — no setup, no menu framing, no 'what do these have in common'; sections named by the phenomenon (The Gut · The Ledger · The Chip · The Floor · The Law · The Market · The Record); the market lands by section six; frontmatter `format: street`; checker S1–S10 in scripts/blog/mdx-cook-check.sh
grounding + scale collision is what EVERY voice is for (operator: 'champagne voice or paradox voice or whatever — grounding is what it's supposed to create; if it doesn't do that we're not doing it right'): land the reader on something they hold physically (the stomach at 3am, the hand on the chip, the floor) and collide it with the same law at a second scale (a ledger, a cache set, a policy) in the same span; impact = the correct impact on the reader; a piece that reads well and does neither is wrong (S10)
agree first — the convergence quartet: four things from four domains, one invariant, and item one is the reader's own body, agreed with at full strength ('you already know this one, and you know it before you can say why'); never 'pop psychology says X, actually Y'; the other three show the same law; one bank data/convergence/instances.json, mint with scripts/blog/quartet.mjs, guard tests/voice/convergence-quartet.test.mjs
a falsifier is a weapon, not a footnote — 'Break it: … That breaks this.' closes every phenomenon section, never pooled into one block at the end; a list that always snaps together is shape, not a finding — only the falsifiers make four agreeing projections into evidence
one coordinate, one occupant — in the prose: short physical sentences, one thing each ('The slot was full. The story was evicted. Your gut is holding the receipt.'); P1 median ≤ 22 words, no sentence over 45; the prose mimics the physics it describes
puffery is comms (operator 2026-09-11): the asides carry the strongest sentence the evidence supports — no hedge, ≤ 70 words, unlabelled; they are the seeds of the outward LinkedIn posts and are never called that on the page; the boundaries live in the sections and the bank, never in the seed
street violence never licenses a debunkable sentence — the rejected overshoots stay on the record with the reason: 'silicon refuses to hallucinate' (metastability IS the compromise; the book files it as a fault), 'Pacioli required a second bookkeeper' (double-entry is one author, two accounts; the second author is separation of duties), 'the gut drop IS the Pauli exclusion principle' (they share the law, not the event), 'agents hallucinate because they have no floor' (the true claim is what an agent's account cannot contain)
validate-mdx COMPILES the MDX (scripts/blog/mdx-compile-check.mjs, @mdx-js/mdx — the next-mdx-remote parser family): a regex pass is not a render; one eaten `>` shipped 'Something went wrong' to production on 2026-09-11 with every regex check green and FORMAT GREEN; guard tests/blog/mdx-compiles.test.mjs; seven back-catalogue posts have never compiled and are listed, not failed
the market-meal (maître d') format is opt-in only — `format: meal` — kept for the back catalogue and for a post that chooses the conceit and says so; a 2026-09-11 cold read scored it predictive 40 · impact 35 · anti-normalisation 45: 'a cognitive traffic jam — the reader pays a crossing tax to decode the metaphor before they can look at the physics'
six-1 predictive power 60→95: a load-bearing term reused more than ten paragraphs after its definition is redefined in the same breath — the cold reader lost "second reader" and "q" on reuse (2026-09-13)
six-2 impact 70→95: a number the reader will be quoted (a 0.2 gain) is closed where it occurs with WHY the scale forbids it — never framed as "the number you might have expected", which a skimmer reads as observed
six-3 confidence 55→95: every term of art gets its one-line plain meaning BEFORE the name (Rice 1953 → no program decides, for all programs, whether they did the right thing) — a bare citation reads as obfuscation to the money persona
six-4 anti-regression 90→95: the mono directions line is scaffolding the checker reads and a reader calls gibberish — it never carries a load-bearing noun the prose does not also carry
six-5 anti-normalisation 75→95: what stuck was the shortest concrete sentence ("a choice with a timestamp") — one stick-able sentence of eight words or fewer per section, and it names an object, not a virtue
six-6 sufficiency 60→95: the Record section names the object under measurement in one plain sentence before the receipts — the reader at the sources asked "what exactly is being monitored"
